name: cursourcing
description: Delegate complete work units to Cursor while Codex sets constraints, handles decisions, and verifies delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Your Codex just hired Cursor. Tokenmaxxing, unlocked.
interface.longDescription: Put available Cursor capacity to work on complete, verifiable tasks. Cursor handles investigation, implementation, and self-checks; your chosen Codex model supplies constraints, resolves blocking decisions, and verifies delivery. Compact results and quiet waits limit avoidable coordination. Supports concurrent tasks, follow-ups, and session recovery. Each service uses its own account and allowance; savings depend on the task and review effort.
defaultPrompt: Use $cursourcing to give Cursor a complete work unit, minimize Codex coordination, and verify the delivered result.
